relationships.subject: Paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: PTX increased phosphorylation of the important microtubule dynamics regulator NEK2 in DRG neurons and induced profound neuropathic allodynia.

relationships.subject: NEK2
relationships.evidence_quote: PTX-activated phosphorylated NEK2 (pNEK2) increased jumonji domain-containing 3 (JMJD3) protein

relationships.subject: JMJD3
relationships.evidence_quote: to specifically catalyze the demethylation of the repressive histone mark H3 lysine 27 trimethylation (H3K27me3) at the Trpv1 gene, thereby enhancing transient receptor potential vanilloid subtype-1 (TRPV1) expression in DRG neurons

relationships.subject: RSK2
relationships.evidence_quote: the pNEK2-dependent PTX response program is regulated by enhancing p90 ribosomal S6 kinase 2 (RSK2) phosphorylation

key_findings: PTX activates a pRSK2/pNEK2/JMJD3/H3K27me3/TRPV1 axis in DRG neurons driving neuropathic allodynia.
Inhibiting RSK2, NEK2, JMJD3 or TRPV1 reversed PTX-induced allodynia in rats.
